product.title: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone Rim and Loop Hike with Lunch

description.text: Trek rim trails along the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone on a six-hour guided hike with included lunch. The route visits Artist Point, Inspiration Point, and viewpoints above the Lower Falls with interpretive commentary on the canyon's hydrothermal coloring and river erosion.

highlights: Six-hour Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone rim hike
Artist Point and Inspiration Point viewpoints
Geology commentary on yellow canyon walls

start.description: Meet at the Canyon Village area trailhead near the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone. Bring hiking boots and rain layer.

end.description: Return to Canyon Village after completing the rim loop and lunch stop.
